起源之光 · 人类从何处来

Origin Light · Where Humans Came From

约300万年前 — 生物 & 考古

~3 Million Years Ago — Biology & Archaeology

生物学考古学人类学地质学

时代背景

Era Background

在非洲大草原上，最早的人类祖先开始直立行走。从石器工具的使用到语言的诞生，人类开始了改变地球的旅程。今天，你所在的城市里还藏着哪些"远古密码"？

On the African savanna, the earliest human ancestors began walking upright. From stone tools to language, humans started their journey to change the Earth. What "ancient codes" are hidden in your city today?

1

城市里的"活化石" —— 寻找原始生命痕迹

Living Fossils in the City — Find Traces of Primitive Life

学科融合：生物学 + 地质学。去城市公园、自然博物馆或河边，寻找存活了上亿年的古老物种（如银杏、水杉、蕨类），记录它们的形态特征，理解生命进化的连续性。

Subjects: Biology + Geology. Visit city parks, natural museums, or riversides to find ancient species that have survived for hundreds of millions of years (ginkgo, dawn redwood, ferns). Record their features and understand the continuity of life evolution.

2

一块石头的故事 —— 城市建筑中的地质密码

The Story of a Stone — Geological Codes in City Buildings

学科融合：地质学 + 考古学。观察城市中不同建筑使用的石材（大理石、花岗岩、砂岩），查阅资料了解它们的形成年代和地质过程。你脚下的城市地基，可能比人类历史还要古老。

Subjects: Geology + Archaeology. Observe the stones used in different city buildings (marble, granite, sandstone), research their formation age and geological processes. The foundation beneath your city may be older than human history.

🔥

火种时代 · 掌握自然之力

Age of Fire · Mastering Nature's Power

约100万年前 — 物理 & 化学

~1 Million Years Ago — Physics & Chemistry

物理学化学材料学工程学

时代背景

Era Background

当人类第一次学会生火，黑夜被点亮，食物被煮熟，金属被锻造。摩擦生热、燃烧反应、热传导——这些物理和化学原理，至今仍在你的厨房和工厂中运转。

When humans first learned to make fire, night was illuminated, food was cooked, and metals were forged. Friction, combustion, heat transfer—these physical and chemical principles still operate in your kitchen and factories today.

1

摩擦生火实验 —— 古人的物理智慧

Friction Fire Experiment — Ancient Physics Wisdom

学科融合：物理学（摩擦、能量转化）+ 化学（燃烧三要素）。在安全环境下用钻木或打火石生火，记录温度变化和所需时间，理解"摩擦生热→达到燃点→有氧燃烧"的完整链条。

Subjects: Physics (friction, energy conversion) + Chemistry (combustion triangle). Safely make fire by friction or flint, record temperature changes and time required, understanding the full chain: friction → ignition point → combustion with oxygen.

2

城市热岛探秘 —— 从篝火到空调的热量之旅

Urban Heat Island — From Campfire to Air Conditioning

学科融合：物理学（热传导、热辐射）+ 地理学（气候）。测量城市不同区域的温度（公园、广场、街道、楼顶），绘制"城市热量地图"，理解人类如何改变地表的热平衡。

Subjects: Physics (heat conduction, radiation) + Geography (climate). Measure temperatures in different city areas (parks, plazas, streets, rooftops), draw a "City Heat Map," and understand how humans alter the surface heat balance.

🏛️

大河文明 · 河流孕育的城市

River Civilizations · Cities Born from Rivers

约5000年前 — 历史 & 地理

~5000 Years Ago — History & Geography

历史学地理学水利学建筑学

时代背景

Era Background

尼罗河、两河、印度河、黄河——四大河流孕育了人类最早的城邦。河流提供水源、肥沃土壤和交通通道，城市规划、水利灌溉、天文历法由此诞生。你所在的城市，是否也有一条"母亲河"？

The Nile, Tigris-Euphrates, Indus, and Yellow River—these four rivers nurtured humanity's earliest city-states. Rivers provided water, fertile soil, and transport routes, giving birth to urban planning, irrigation, and calendars. Does your city also have a "mother river"?

1

寻找城市的"母亲河" —— 水系与文明

Find the City's "Mother River" — Water Systems & Civilization

学科融合：地理学（水文、地形）+ 历史学（城市发展）。追溯你所在城市的主要河流/水源，绘制"城市水系地图"，标注古桥、古码头、水坝遗址，理解"因水而生、依水而兴"的城市规律。

Subjects: Geography (hydrology, topography) + History (urban development). Trace your city's main river/water source, draw a "City Water System Map," mark ancient bridges, docks, and dam ruins. Understand the rule: cities are born from and thrive on water.

2

古城墙的秘密 —— 从防御工程到城市边界

Secrets of Ancient City Walls — From Defense to Urban Boundaries

学科融合：建筑学 + 历史学 + 数学（几何）。测量或查找本地古城墙/城门遗址的数据（高度、厚度、周长），计算其土方量，思考古代工程师如何解决结构稳定和排水问题。

Subjects: Architecture + History + Mathematics (geometry). Measure or research your local ancient city wall/gate ruins (height, thickness, perimeter), calculate earthwork volume, and think about how ancient engineers solved structural stability and drainage.

🐫

丝路千年 · 东西方相遇

Silk Road Era · East Meets West

约2000年前 — 地理 & 文化

~2000 Years Ago — Geography & Culture

地理学历史学文化研究经济学

时代背景

Era Background

从长安到罗马，丝绸、香料、瓷器和知识沿着陆上与海上丝路流通。不同文明在碰撞中融合，城市成为多元文化的熔炉。今天的你，能否在自己的城市找到"丝路痕迹"？

From Chang'an to Rome, silk, spices, porcelain, and knowledge flowed along land and maritime Silk Roads. Different civilizations fused through collision, and cities became melting pots of diverse cultures. Can you find "Silk Road traces" in your city today?

1

城市里的"丝路痕迹" —— 追踪跨文化印记

Silk Road Traces in the City — Tracking Cross-Cultural Marks

学科融合：文化研究 + 历史学 + 地理学。寻找城市中与丝路相关的建筑、宗教遗址、外来植物（如葡萄、石榴）、地名由来，绘制一张"本地丝路文化地图"，向海外伙伴介绍你的发现。

Subjects: Cultural Studies + History + Geography. Find Silk Road-related architecture, religious sites, foreign plants (grapes, pomegranates), and place name origins in your city. Draw a "Local Silk Road Culture Map" and introduce your findings to overseas partners.

2

模拟商队 —— 计算古代贸易的成本与利润

Simulate a Caravan — Calculate Ancient Trade Costs & Profits

学科融合：经济学 + 地理学（距离、地形）+ 数学。选择一种古代商品（丝绸、茶叶、香料），研究其产地与目的地，估算古代运输路线、时间和成本，理解"距离=价值"的贸易逻辑。

Subjects: Economics + Geography (distance, terrain) + Mathematics. Choose an ancient commodity (silk, tea, spices), research its origin and destination, estimate ancient transport routes, time, and costs. Understand the trade logic: distance = value.

⚓

大航海时代 · 突破边界

Age of Exploration · Breaking Boundaries

约500年前 — 地理 & 天文

~500 Years Ago — Geography & Astronomy

地理学天文学物理学制图学

时代背景

Era Background

指南针、星盘、帆船——人类第一次将世界连成一体。经纬度、洋流、季风，地理与天文的结合让远洋航行成为可能。今天的 GPS 和古代航海术，本质上都在解决同一个问题：我在哪里？

Compass, astrolabe, sailing ships—humanity first connected the world into one. Latitude, longitude, ocean currents, monsoons: the fusion of geography and astronomy made ocean voyages possible. Today's GPS and ancient navigation both solve the same problem: where am I?

1

不用GPS导航 —— 用太阳和星星找方向

Navigate Without GPS — Use Sun and Stars for Direction

学科融合：天文学（星象、太阳高度角）+ 物理学（磁学、指南针原理）+ 地理学。学习用太阳位置、北极星和简易指南针判断方向，在公园内完成一次"无GPS定向徒步"，记录误差并分析原因。

Subjects: Astronomy (stars, sun altitude) + Physics (magnetism, compass) + Geography. Learn to use sun position, Polaris, and a simple compass for direction. Complete a "no-GPS orienteering hike" in a park, record errors, and analyze causes.

2

绘制你的"城市海图" —— 从港口到全球化

Draw Your "City Sea Chart" — From Port to Globalization

学科融合：地理学（港口、航线）+ 历史学（贸易史）。研究你所在城市（或最近港口）的对外贸易航线，标注主要进出口商品来源地，理解这座城市如何被大航海时代塑造。

Subjects: Geography (ports, routes) + History (trade). Research your city's (or nearest port's) foreign trade routes, mark main import/export origins, and understand how the Age of Exploration shaped this city.

⚡

蒸汽与电 · 机器改变城市

Steam & Electricity · Machines Transform Cities

约200年前 — 物理 & 化学

~200 Years Ago — Physics & Chemistry

物理学化学机械工程社会学

时代背景

Era Background

蒸汽机轰鸣，电灯照亮街道，工厂拔地而起。热力学定律、电磁感应、化学反应——科学原理第一次大规模转化为城市动力。你每天的电力、交通、通信，都源于这个时代的创造。

Steam engines roared, electric lights illuminated streets, and factories rose. Laws of thermodynamics, electromagnetic induction, chemical reactions—scientific principles were first transformed into urban power at scale. Your daily electricity, transport, and communication all originate from this era's creations.

1

城市电力追踪 —— 从发电厂到插座的能量之旅

City Power Trace — From Power Plant to Outlet

学科融合：物理学（电磁感应、电路）+ 化学（电池、燃料）+ 工程学。调查你所在城市的主要电力来源（火电、水电、风电、光伏），绘制"城市电力地图"，计算不同能源的碳排放对比。

Subjects: Physics (electromagnetic induction, circuits) + Chemistry (batteries, fuels) + Engineering. Investigate your city's main power sources (thermal, hydro, wind, solar), draw a "City Power Map," and calculate carbon emission comparisons.

2

老工业遗址探访 —— 机器背后的物理化学

Visit Old Industrial Sites — Physics & Chemistry Behind Machines

学科融合：物理学（力学、热学）+ 化学（冶金、材料）+ 历史学。探访城市中的老工厂、旧车站或工业博物馆，观察蒸汽机、纺织机、高炉等设备，理解能量转换和材料科学的实际应用。

Subjects: Physics (mechanics, thermodynamics) + Chemistry (metallurgy, materials) + History. Visit old factories, stations, or industrial museums. Observe steam engines, textile machines, blast furnaces, and understand energy conversion and materials science in practice.

💻

数字纪元 · 比特重塑世界

Digital Age · Bits Reshape the World

约50年前 — 计算机 & 信息

~50 Years Ago — Computer Science & Information

计算机科学信息论数学社会学

时代背景

Era Background

从第一台计算机到智能手机，从拨号上网到5G，数字技术用0和1重新编码了城市。算法推荐、智能交通、移动支付——信息流动的速度，定义了现代城市的效率。但数字鸿沟也随之产生。

From the first computer to smartphones, from dial-up to 5G, digital technology recoded cities with 0s and 1s. Algorithmic recommendations, smart traffic, mobile payments—the speed of information flow defines modern urban efficiency. But the digital divide also emerged.

1

一天不用手机 —— 体验"数字断联"后的城市

A Day Without Phones — Experience the City After "Digital Disconnect"

学科融合：社会学 + 信息科学 + 心理学。记录一天不使用移动支付、导航、社交软件的生活，观察城市中不依赖数字技术的生存方式（现金、地图、面对面交流），反思技术与人性的平衡。

Subjects: Sociology + Information Science + Psychology. Record one day without mobile payments, navigation, or social apps. Observe non-digital survival in the city (cash, paper maps, face-to-face communication). Reflect on the balance between technology and humanity.

2

算法之眼 —— 观察智能系统如何管理你的城市

The Eye of Algorithms — How Smart Systems Manage Your City

学科融合：计算机科学（算法、数据）+ 数学（统计、优化）+ 社会学。调研城市中使用的智能系统（红绿灯调度、垃圾清运路线、公交排班），采访管理者或查阅资料，理解"数据→算法→决策"的城市治理逻辑。

Subjects: Computer Science (algorithms, data) + Mathematics (statistics, optimization) + Sociology. Research smart systems in your city (traffic light scheduling, garbage routes, bus timetables). Interview managers or research materials to understand the "data → algorithm → decision" urban governance logic.

🚀

未来之城 · 由你创造

City of the Future · Created by You

2050+ — 跨学科综合

2050+ — Interdisciplinary Synthesis

综合科学设计思维未来学跨文化协作

时代背景

Era Background

当AI、基因编辑、可控核聚变、太空移民从科幻变为可能，城市会是什么样子？没有标准答案，因为你的想象就是未来的蓝图。和全球伙伴一起，用你所学的全部知识，设计一座属于2050年的理想城市。

When AI, gene editing, fusion power, and space colonization move from sci-fi to possibility, what will cities look like? There is no standard answer—your imagination is the blueprint. Work with global partners and use all the knowledge you've gained to design an ideal city for 2050.

1

城市诊断 —— 找出你所在城市的3个关键问题

City Diagnosis — Identify 3 Key Problems in Your City

学科融合：全部学科综合运用。基于前面7个时代的探索，从交通、能源、环境、文化、公平等维度，诊断你所在城市当前最紧迫的3个问题，用数据和实地观察支撑你的结论。

Subjects: All disciplines combined. Based on explorations through the previous 7 eras, diagnose the 3 most urgent problems in your city from transportation, energy, environment, culture, and equity dimensions. Support your conclusions with data and field observations.

2

跨国共创 —— 设计2050年理想城市

Global Co-Creation — Design the Ideal City of 2050

学科融合：跨学科综合 + 跨国协作。与海外小组伙伴合作，每组负责未来城市的一个子系统（交通/能源/居住/文化/治理），产出方案文档、模型或数字沙盘，在社区展示并接受全球投票。

Subjects: Interdisciplinary + Cross-border collaboration. Partner with overseas teammates, each team responsible for one subsystem of the future city (transport/energy/housing/culture/governance). Produce plan documents, models, or digital sandboxes, showcase in the community, and receive global votes.
